note: Extracted by hand from the ordering schematic. The model column pairs the body and clamp with the flow orientation, ten forms. The special options position follows the sheet's own rule, combine up to two options in alphabetical order, so the slot enumerates every single and every alphabetical pair; a build with no options assembles with a trailing dash here, and whether the factory prints the bare form without it is held for John. The electropolish options keep their printed body pairings, and the sheet's reorder warning, that order codes and lay-in dimensions changed in 2014 and 2020, belongs with any replacement enquiry. The registry name is 9093 because the printed 93 codes carry their body letter in the model column itself.
